:::{#def-jump-discontinuity}
#### Jump discontinuity

A function $f$ has a **jump discontinuity** at $c$
if both one-sided limits (@def-one-sided-limit)
$\lim_{x \to c^-} f(x)$ and $\lim_{x \to c^+} f(x)$ exist
but are not equal.
Then $\lim_{x \to c} f(x)$ does not exist,
so $f$ is discontinuous at $c$ (@def-continuous).

:::
